scenario: The ego vehicle turns left at a signalized intersection while an adversarial vehicle approaches from the opposite direction straight through the intersection.

ego.behavior: The car turns left at the intersection and proceeds along the curved trajectory.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection from the opposite direction.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on the westbound approach of a four-way signalized intersection, positioned to turn left, while the adversarial vehicle starts on the northbound approach traveling straight south through the intersection; their paths converge at the estimated collision point near the center of the intersection.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must approach the intersection from a defined initial distance; the scenario terminates upon completion of the intersection traversal or upon reaching the estimated collision point with the adversarial vehicle.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the VUT labeled car turning left; the adversarial is the opposing red car. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initial both approach intersection; midpoint ego initiates left turn while adversarial proceeds straight; ending paths cross at estimated collision point. 4. Evidence: blue curved arrow shows ego trajectory; red car's straight path opposes; traffic lights visible at corners confirm signalized intersection.
